To Whom It May Concern,  

I have had the pleasure of engaging with Daichi Kobayashi in the context of academic collaboration, specifically through his participation in a research partnership focused on SaaS industry trends. While our interactions were not frequent, they were consistently meaningful, offering insight into his professional rigor and intellectual engagement.  

Daichi’s approach to product management is defined by a deep commitment to aligning technical execution with strategic vision. He demonstrated exceptional skill in competitive analysis, consistently identifying market gaps that informed NexGen’s product roadmap. For instance, his analysis of emerging SaaS pricing models enabled the team to refine their tiered subscription strategy, resulting in a 15% increase in mid-market adoption. His ability to translate abstract market insights into actionable roadmap milestones was instrumental in maintaining alignment across engineering, sales, and customer success teams.  

A standout aspect of his work was his methodical approach to user journey mapping. During a recent overhaul of NexGen’s onboarding process, he led a cross-functional effort to dissect pain points in the customer lifecycle. By prioritizing friction points identified through SQL-driven analytics, his team reduced user drop-off rates by 22% within three months. This project underscored his knack for balancing data precision with empathetic design.  

Daichi’s dedication to fostering collaboration and his curiosity about systemic challenges make him a rare asset. His work ethic and intellectual humility are equally compelling.  

Sincerely,  
[Professor’s Name]  
[University Affiliation]
